playbookCatalogue.situation: The learner needs a durable, rich, textbook-like section that teaches a coherent body of knowledge for later reference.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: The learner needs one correction, a short hint, retrieval practice or an assessment.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: No tracked Question Block by default. When an informal MCQ block is planned, use a purposeful 3-5 question set rather than a single token question.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: A key idea needs a clear explanation, misconception repair and a bounded informal check of 5-10 questions.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: The learner needs a formal tracked test, a large reference chapter or only one diagnostic question.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Informal MCQ by default, normally 5-10 questions in one final MCQ block. A tracked Question Block is allowed only when explicitly requested and canonically verified.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: The learner explicitly needs a short, in-class-style tracked test of 10-15 questions.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Canonical subtopic resolution is unverified or the learner needs teaching before assessment.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exactly one final tracked Question Block, 10-15 questions, approximately 60% entry-to-build and 40% build-to-peak.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: A missing prerequisite prevents progress on the learner's current objective.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: The obstacle is a misconception within the current concept rather than a prerequisite gap.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Informal readiness checks only unless a tracked assessment is explicitly requested and verified.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: There is concrete evidence of a conceptual, procedural or exam-technique error to diagnose and repair.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: No actual mistake evidence exists or the learner simply needs first teaching.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Informal retry by default; tracked only when explicitly requested and verified.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: The learner benefits from modelling followed by deliberately faded support and an independent attempt.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: The task is pure recall or the learner already demonstrates the complete method.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Independent attempt is informal unless explicit tracked intent is verified.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: The learner needs a durable revision resource combining organisation, retrieval and correction.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: The learner needs first teaching or a formal timed assessment.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Informal retrieval by default.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: The learner needs to understand question demand, response anatomy and how to improve an exam-style answer.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: The learner is in a live independent assessment or only needs content recall.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Tracked only when explicitly requested and canonically verified.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Distinguish easily confused concepts by explicit criteria and varied borderline examples, then justify classifications.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Not simply a list of definitions.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Predict, vary a controlled feature in a valid model, observe and explain, stating model assumptions and limits.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Do not substitute click exploration for explanation or assessment.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Read and interpret supplied quantitative data; connect values, trends, anomalies and uncertainty to a justified conclusion.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Do not invent observations or treat correlation as causation.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Plan or evaluate a practical enquiry with a testable question, variables, measurement choices, supplied safety constraints, analysis and limitations.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Not a generic video explanation or an unverified school safety protocol.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Interrogate supplied sources through provenance, contextual reading and corroboration; distinguish what each can establish.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Do not infer factual reliability from an image or a topic label.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Construct and examine claims, evidence and warrants; consider counter-evidence and qualify an argument while preserving learner authorship.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Not a completed assessed essay or a hierarchy that invents support links.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Read a supplied short text closely; connect exact words and structure to plausible effects and alternative interpretations.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Do not invent quotations, intentions or an entire model answer.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Make writing choices for audience, purpose and form; use bounded models, learner drafting and purposeful revision.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Not an answer-completion service for Smart Homework.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Use labelled verified visual examples to identify observable features, compare cases and apply distinctions to a new example.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Images must let the learner infer something; no decorative galleries.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Investigate a bounded case at the correct place, time and scale; connect drivers, evidence, impacts and responses to a judgement.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Do not make a generic topic summary look like verified case evidence.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Interpret map conventions and scale, locate and compare spatial patterns, and use spatial evidence to explain or evaluate.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Do not invent coordinates or rely on a photograph for spatial relationships.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Trace an interacting qualitative system, compare bounded changes and explain consequences and limits; numeric simulation requires a supplied model.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: No invented quantitative causal strengths or misleading energy-flow counts.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Connect visible structure at a stated scale to a mechanism, function and constraint, using appropriate biological, physical or chemical representations.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: A molecule diagram cannot stand in for a cell or a folded enzyme.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Translate the same idea across two representations, expose correspondences and non-equivalences, then choose a representation for a task.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: No unconnected collection of charts, equations and diagrams.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Compare realistic options using stated criteria, supplied evidence and tradeoffs; justify and revisit a decision.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: Not a single predetermined answer or an ungrounded pros-and-cons list.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

playbookCatalogue.situation: Prepare a learner to explain or defend an idea aloud using concise cues, probing questions, revision and self-check.
playbookCatalogue.avoidWhen: No assumed speech-recognition capability or automatic proficiency from rehearsal.
playbookCatalogue.assessmentPolicy: Exploration and informal checks are local. Explicit assessment only through a separately validated Question Block with canonical resolution. Preserve learner authorship.

qualityRequirements.purpose: Representations need distinct educational purposes and explicit what-to-notice guidance. No diversity quota or count padding.

formationCatalogue.situation: Several related concepts must be built into one coherent mental model.
evidenceRequirements: Use external evidence only when the stimulus is necessary and verified.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Synthesis of the main model, its connections and one retrieval prompt.

formationCatalogue.situation: A process, cycle or interacting system must be understood in stages and as a whole.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Synthesis of the main model, its connections and one retrieval prompt.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner must connect a concept to verified evidence or a case study.
evidenceRequirements: Use external evidence only when the stimulus is necessary and verified.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Synthesis of the main model, its connections and one retrieval prompt.

formationCatalogue.situation: Evidence shows one or more specific misconceptions.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Correct model, easily confused contrast and a concise understanding check.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner confuses two or more similar ideas, terms or methods.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Correct model, easily confused contrast and a concise understanding check.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner knows isolated facts but cannot connect cause, mechanism and outcome.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Correct model, easily confused contrast and a concise understanding check.

formationCatalogue.situation: A representative mix of knowledge, sequencing and extended application is needed.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: The final Question Block closes the document; do not add teaching after it.

formationCatalogue.situation: The test must use a chart, map, image or table as a shared stimulus.
evidenceRequirements: Use external evidence only when the stimulus is necessary and verified.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: The final Question Block closes the document; do not add teaching after it.

formationCatalogue.situation: The assessment focuses on a method, working or exam-response technique.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: The final Question Block closes the document; do not add teaching after it.

formationCatalogue.situation: One missing idea blocks the target.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Prerequisite-to-target connection and a short readiness decision.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner needs a missing method or operation.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Prerequisite-to-target connection and a short readiness decision.

formationCatalogue.situation: Two or three prerequisites must be reconnected.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Prerequisite-to-target connection and a short readiness decision.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner's underlying model is wrong.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: First wrong turn, corrected rule and a same-family retry cue.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner knows the idea but applies a method incorrectly.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: First wrong turn, corrected rule and a same-family retry cue.

formationCatalogue.situation: Marks were lost because the response did not meet the command word, evidence or structure requirement.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: First wrong turn, corrected rule and a same-family retry cue.

formationCatalogue.situation: A repeatable method can be shown and faded.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Method checkpoints, reflection on the fade and independent next step.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner must build a multi-link causal explanation.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Method checkpoints, reflection on the fade and independent next step.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner must construct an extended response while retaining authorship.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Method checkpoints, reflection on the fade and independent next step.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner needs one structured overview with retrieval checks.

formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: High-signal recap plus a concrete spaced-retrieval action.

formationCatalogue.situation: Several related concepts need mixed retrieval and discrimination.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: High-signal recap plus a concrete spaced-retrieval action.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner must plan and construct a longer evaluative or analytical answer.
evidenceRequirements: Canonical curriculum context and authenticated learner evidence are normally sufficient.
formationCatalogue.closingPurpose: Response checklist, self-review prompt and independent exam-style action.

formationCatalogue.situation: The learner needs precision on short command-word questions.
